exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 to 2.
Calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) according to Cockcroft-Gault formula and based on ideal body weight or 24-hour urine CrCl ≥ 50 mL/minute
Aspartate aminotransferase and alanine transaminase ≤ 2.5 × ULN (≤ 5 × ULN for participants with liver metastases)
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN (≤ 5 × ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN or direct bilirubin ≤ ULN for participants with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 × ULN.
Participants who have T-cell lymphoma with active central nervous system involvement.
History of invasive prior malignancy that required systemic therapy within last 3 years.
Known to be positive for HIV, or positive test for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection
Females who are pregnant, lactating, or intend to become pregnant during their participation in the study
